definition: Completely absorbed by something, so that it holds all one's attention.
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
quote: Sometimes when Colin felt Ben’s earnest gaze meant that he was much impressed he wondered what he was reflecting on and once when he had seemed quite entranced he questioned him.
example_sentence: The audience sat entranced by the violinist.
